sources.title: GFSEC members to begin coordinated action against steel excess capacity, OECD official says: Alacero Summit 2026
evidence: GFSEC members would begin implementing the Milwaukee Framework for Joint Action immediately
with progress and the effectiveness of the measures to be reported to ministers in the fall of 2027.
The framework, adopted by the forum’s 28 members on September 30, aims to coordinate national efforts
Chinese steel exports reached a record 131 million tonnes in 2025, up by 153% from 2020.
The actions will remain national measures, reflecting each country’s circumstances and international obligations
Among the priority measures being pursued are stronger import monitoring systems
closer scrutiny of suspicious trade patterns
efforts to identify circumvention or evasion of trade measures.
The forum will also hold annual discussions to assess the measures adopted
